This selection adds the actual van Kampen quotient presentation and the fundamental group of a wedge of circles from TauCetiProject/TauCeti, commit 1f9b4414105d86e487a4ac4c3d3397076a44d0d2, under Apache-2.0. It retains every original author and copyright header, including Kim Morrison and The Tau Ceti contributors. The existing complete Tau Ceti LICENSE is byte-identical to that fixed upstream license. Local adaptations make imports public, give original Tau Ceti imports the existing local module prefix, and explicitly declare the implicit basepoint described below; reversing all recorded local edits restores every original source byte. The 46 added modules and seven reused modules are listed in VK_EXTENSION_UPSTREAM.json. Compilation and the project's transitive axiom audit remain pending. This selection supplies genuine topological tools; the canonical handle-surface attaching-word comparison remains a separate mathematical proof.

The local adaptation in `AlgebraicTopology/FundamentalGroup/Basic.lean` explicitly declares the implicit basepoint `a₀ : A`. The upstream file relied on automatic implicit binding, while this project disables `autoImplicit`. This preserves the original mathematical quantification and all proof bodies. The manifest records the exact reversible binder edit in addition to the import edits.
